name: When should I consider a full kitchen layout redesign instead of just a refresh?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a full kitchen layout redesign instead of just a refresh?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a full kitchen layout redesign if your current kitchen suffers from poor functionality, an inefficient work triangle, or insufficient space that a cosmetic refresh cannot fix. If you need to move major appliances, add an island, or open up the kitchen to another room, a redesign is necessary. A redesign is also beneficial if your family's needs have changed significantly, or if you're looking to substantially increase your home's value and appeal through a more modern or functional layout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Opt for a full redesign when your kitchen has poor functionality, an inefficient layout, or when you need to move major elements or expand the space.
